name: Source of Power

angles.text: The Forsaken rely on the Royal Apothecary Society’s ruthless innovations to survive in Lordaeron. Helping Doctor Felben advances the faction’s arcane fleshcraft research under the Dark Lady’s watch.
Horde adventurers in Lordaeron support the Forsaken’s efforts to secure advanced military assets against their rivals while Dalaran is crippled by its rogue creations.
Mages may find grim irony in Dalaran’s constructs turning on their masters, while their arcane power sources are plundered for gruesome experiments in Undercity.
Engineers can appreciate the craft behind Dalaran’s autonomous sentries, even as their delicate arcane cores are torn out to fuel horrific fleshcraft abominations.

faq.answer: Doctor Martin Felben gives it. He is an apothecary residing in Undercity, the Forsaken capital, and seeks to prove his alchemical talents to the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner by creating new military monstrosities.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Source of Power?

faq.answer: Dalaran is under siege by its own arcane constructs, which have turned against their creators. The fighting creates an opening for outsiders to enter the city and salvage the magical components powering the rogue sentries.
faq.q: What is happening in Dalaran during this quest?

aliases: what does felben need cores for
faq.answer: Doctor Felben wants to use the arcane energy in Dalaran’s sentry cores to augment Forsaken abominations. By synthesizing arcane machinery with fleshcraft, he hopes to create an army of arcane-powered abominations and prove his alchemical mastery to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
faq.q: Why does Doctor Felben want the construct cores?

aliases: how many cores do i need
what to collect for source of power
faq.answer: You are sent into Dalaran to confront the rogue constructs and gather six Cracked Sentry Cores. Then you bring them to Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity for his ongoing experiments.
faq.q: What are the objectives for Source of Power?

aliases: who leads the royal apothecary society
faq.answer: Doctor Martin Felben seeks recognition and rapid advancement among the Forsaken. He hopes a formidable force of arcane-infused abominations will impress Lady Sylvanas Windrunner enough for her to name him head of the Royal Apothecary Society.
faq.q: What is Doctor Felben's goal within the Royal Apothecary Society?

faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society and the Forsaken seek unconventional weapons and power sources to ensure their survival in Lordaeron. While Dalaran’s defenses collapse from within, Forsaken apothecaries can take its sophisticated arcane components without formally engaging the magi in open warfare.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken scavenging Dalaran's technology?

aliases: where to find cracked sentry cores
faq.answer: Cracked Sentry Cores come from rogue constructs laying siege to Dalaran. You gather them from the hostile enchanted guardians across the city for Doctor Felben’s research in Undercity.
faq.q: Where are the Cracked Sentry Cores found?

sections.body: Dalaran’s rogue arcane constructs are laying siege to the magi, and the Forsaken are eager to exploit the city’s turmoil. Doctor Martin Felben, an apothecary in Undercity, seeks to scavenge the cores that power the sentries rather than aid the besieged sorcerers. Dalaran has long guarded its magical research, but its vulnerable sentries now offer an opening to opportunistic researchers.
sections.title: An Opportunistic Harvest

sections.body: Doctor Felben wants the cracked sentry cores to advance his standing within the Royal Apothecary Society. He hopes to infuse Forsaken abominations with volatile Dalaran construct magic and raise a devastating army of arcane-powered flesh beasts. Such a breakthrough, he believes, would win Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s undivided attention and show his alchemical genius. He hopes to rise in the Society, where ruthless cunning and potent results dictate survival and rank.
sections.title: Ambition in the Apothecary Society

summary: In Dalaran, rogue constructs have turned on their makers, and Doctor Martin Felben sees a chance for the Forsaken. He wants their arcane cores for his work in Undercity and hopes to catch the Dark Lady’s eye.
